metadata.title: Yardlong beans & Dried fish | Kharek Nakam | Garo Recipe
metadata.description:
This is a real simple mouthwatering Garo (A'chik) dish which made with yardlong beans and dried fish. 

Beans are cut in to bite size pieces and boiled along with dried fish and a hint of cooking soda or lye obtained from the banana stem. 

The dish is prepared when the beans and the dried fish are boiled soft. This dish is usually served as a side to steamed rice.
